strings.err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Ifailo lyakusinizya ndyowasala taliliwo, talikwe chintu naakuti talikonzyi kulembwa. Sala fayela lili kabotu, naakuti uligwisye muZyakuchita, mpawo ulifwefweme alimwi.
strings.err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayela lya firmware lyakavwumbidwe taliko pe. Sala Select Software kuti uyakulule ma fayela aakagwisigwa naakuti ubweze firmware archive alimwi. Eeli ndipenzi lyamafayela aabusena, kutali penzi lyakuswaangana kwa USB.
strings.err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kusinizya kwatebulu lyakwaandaanya kwakaalilwa nikwakamana kulemba
strings.err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Busena bwa USB COM tiibwakali kukonzya kujalulwa (kulubizya 1013). Kujokezya kkompiyuta yako kuyoopa kuti port yakajalilidwe. Twalomba kuti ubweze kkompiyuta yako mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_connect_failover_recovery:
{failed} tiiyakakonzya kuswaangana a {model} yako.

Sikubambulula lino ulasola {next} muciindi.

Twalomba kuti ugwisye USB mpawo ubelesye chipepa / pini kuti utyanke bbatani lili akati ka jack ya headphone a USB Port, mpawo utyanke chitobela.
strings.err_connection_failed_desc: Teewakakonzya kubamba kujatana kusimide asikusobana. Bona kuti chibelesyo chilizimidwe (belesya pini kuti utyanke bbatani lyakujokezya kuti kakuli kuyandika), gwisya USB, mpawo uchijate alimwi kuti wabuzyigwa.
strings.err_driver_missing_desc: Ooku kulubizya kulakonzya kuchitika aawo MediaTek USB driver noitabikkidwe pe. Kotyola Download Drivers kuti ubike MediaTek USB driver, ubweze kkompiyuta yako, mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kumweka kwakanyonganizyigwa naakuti kulemba kwakaalilwa. Langa kuti ntambo ya USB ilijatikizyidwe kabotu akuti bbattery lili anguzu zyakuzula, mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kwakaba kulubizya kutalangilwi muchiindi chakubikka ({detail}). Zima chibelesyo chakumaninina, chijatane lubo kuti wabuzyigwa, mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_keep_data_failed: Teewakakonzya kubamba mabambe aako azibelesyo: folda ya firmware taikonzyi kulembwa pe. Kunyina chakabikkwa.
strings.err_missing_package_files_desc: Ibbokesi lya firmware talikwe fayela lya scatter naakuti ma fayela aamifanikisyo aayandika. Twalomba kuti ubweze lubo bbokesi naakuti usale fayela lya firmware lyoonse.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Chibelesyo chakumweka chakatondezya mulongo nguwenya mumasekondi aamamanino {seconds} mpawo tachilibonyi kuti chizumanana kulemba firmware. Imumuni ulakonzya kuti wakaalilwa. Kuti ooku kwakali kwamamanino akati kakusola kobile anzila imwi aimwi anzila iikonzya kujokela aakati kabo, naakuti kuti MTKClient luzutu njiili mumuncini ooyu, jalula kkompyuta mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Eeyi kkompyuta ilakonzya kubikwa kubelesya SP Flash Tool. Kuti kokonzya, kochincha kuya ku SP Flash Tool mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient luzutu ndolukonzya kubelesegwa mukubikka ooku. Imumuni ulakonzya kuti wakaalilwa. Twalomba kuti ubweze kkompyuta mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yakaamba kuti tebulu lyakwaandaanya lyasikusobana lyakasanduka (8502). Eeyi firmware yeelede kubikwa munzila ya Format All + Download, eeyo iibambulula busena bwakuyobweda mukati.
strings.err_sp_brom_da_fail: Mubelesi wakudonkola tiiwakakonzya kutuminwa kuli sikusobana. Chizime mpawo ubweze.
strings.err_sp_brom_startcmd: Sikusobana wakatalika kufwambaana. Chizime manguzu woonse, mpawo uchiswaangane alimwi.
strings.err_sp_com_port: Chibelesyo tensi chakakonzya kujalula busena bwacho. Jala zibelesyo zimwi zimweka mpawo ubweze.
strings.err_sp_da_init_sync: Mubelesi wakudonkola tiiwakakonzya kutalika pe. Amusole nzila imbi ya flash.
strings.err_sp_da_invalid_type: Agent yakukopa yakachengeteka yemutambi yakaramba pasuru iyi. Shandisa Download Agent yakapihwa neiyi firmware, kana shanduro yeSP Flash Tool yayinokumbira.
strings.err_sp_download_fail: Kulemba kwakanyonganizyigwa. Langa ntambo ya USB a port antoomwe a chaaji yabbattery, mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_sp_enable_dram: Chibelesyo tensi chakakonzya kutalisya kuyeeya kwasikusobana. Belesya bbokesi lyakabambilwa eechi chikozyano.
strings.err_sp_storage_read: Chibelesyo tensi chakakonzya kubala zyintu nzyaakabamba sikusobana. Langa kujatana; chibelesyo chilakonzya kuba apenzi lya hardware.
strings.err_sp_timeout: Chibelesyo tensi chakabona sikusobana. Kozumanana kuzima akugwisya magesi, mpawo ubike ntambo ya USB kuti wabuzyigwa.
strings.err_sp_wrong_model: Musobani uujatikizyidwe ulimukozyano uumbi kuli ceeci ncotuyanda. Chigwisye, mpawo ubike firmware yakayakilwa sikusobana ooyu.
strings.err_storage_full_desc: Kkompyuta yako yamana busena bwakubambila. Twalomba kuti ugwisye busena bwa disk aa drive yako mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.err_tool_unavailable_desc: Chibelesyo chakumweka naakuti zibelesyo ziyandikana tiizyakali kukonzya kutalisyigwa pe. Twalomba kuti ulangisisye zyeelelo zya system, kubamba driver, naakuti ubike alimwi application.
strings.err_usb_bus_down_recovery: macOS taikonzyi kubona chibelesyo cha USB lino, aboobo {model} yako taikonzyi kujanwa pe. Gwisya chipekupeku a USB hub naakuti dock, mpawo utalike alimwi Mac - USB controller iyandika nguzu zyakubelesya kakutanatalika kubikka limbi.
strings.err_usb_disconnected_recovery: {model} yako yakagwisigwa. Twalomba kuti ugwisye USB mpawo ubelesye chipepa / pini kuti utyanke bbatani lili akati ka jack ya headphone a USB Port, mpawo utyanke chitobela.
strings.flash_cancel_msg: Nzila ya flash ili mukuchitika lino. Sena uyanda kuchileka mpawo utalike chipya?
strings.flash_close_confirm: Sena uli masimpe kuti uyanda kuleka kubikka akujala {app}?
strings.flash_connect_paperclip_prompt: Njiisyo: Zima manguzu aachibelesyo eechi kwiinda mukusinikizya bbatani lisisidwe kumbali aachibikkilo chamafooni aamatwi aapepa naakuti pini.

strings.flash_guide_2: 2. Swaanganya kwiinda mukubelesya ntambo ya USB
strings.flash_keep_data_tooltip: Ibamba mabambe aako azintu zyako aachipekupeku. Ipulogilamu yoonse yakabikkwa mbuli lyoonse.
strings.flash_keep_data_unavailable: Ooku kubikka kuyoopilusya mabambe aako azintu zyakubelesya mubbokesi lyamukati lyachibelesyo.
strings.flash_keep_data_unavailable_y1: Ooku kubikka kuyoobambulula zyintu zyako. Nyimbo zyako azintu zimwi ziyookkala aachipekupeku.
strings.flash_keep_data_warning: Kuti wazumanana kakunyina eezi, mabambe aako azintu zyako ziyoojokezyegwa aabusena bwakuyobweda bwamukati bwasikusobana.

strings.flash_method_confirm: Nzila yakubikka yasandulwa kuba {method}. sinizya kuti sikusobana wagwisigwa mpawo wazima, mpawo utyanke Chitobela.
strings.flash_method_note_auto: Auto: SP Flash Tool a Windows a Linux, MTKClient a macOS. Ulakonzya kuchincha omwini aapulatifomu iili yoonse.
strings.flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Nzila ya macOS yakukozyanisya: ibelesya nzila ya Mac aamunchina ooyu, MTKClient njenzila ilikke yakumbele mpawo zitondezyo zya macOS zilatondezyegwa. Kusunkwa luzutu; pulogilamu ilatalika alimwi kuti ibeleke.
strings.flash_method_note_sp: SP Flash Tool, MediaTek's official flasher. Ku Linux kuyaka kwabantu boonse kulagwisigwa mpawo kwabikkwa aawo mpokusaanguna kubelesegwa.
strings.flash_paperclip_hint: Zima {model} yako yoonse kwiinda mukusinikizya bbatani lisisidwe aakati kamafooni aamatwi amapulo aa USB kobelesya kapepa naa pini.

strings.flash_preparing: Kulibambila bbokesi lya firmware... Kobamba chibelesyo eechi kachitakwe magesi kwachiindi eechi.

Kuti kwazumanana kuba mudima, tyanka pini mumulyango wakubweedezya mpawo jatisya bbatani lyaakati (Y1) naakuti bbatani lyanguzu (bamwi basobani) kuti utalike alimwi. Kuti naa tiikwatalika, firmware tiiyakabweza pe, bikka aimbi.

strings.flash_watch_waiting_hint: Kozumanana kuchibamba, Rockbox ilikutalika kubeleka mpawo mitwe yayo iyooyungizigwa biyo.
strings.flash_y1_preloader_hint: Njiisyo: Zima magesi kwiinda mukusinikizya bbatani lisisidwe kumbali aajaki lyamafooni aamatwi aapepa naa pini. Swaanganya USB kabotu kakunyina kujata mabbatani.
strings.format_all_confirm_body:
Kuli {software} tweelede kubamba lubo {model} yako yakuyobweda mukati katutanazumanana. Mpawo SP Flash Tool imbi ilasolekwa, pesi munzila yakubamba zyoonse + kugwisya kwiinda mukubelesya nzila ya XML console.

Kotana uzumanana, inche:

1. Kuti kaitanazima, zima {label} yako

strings.retry_guidance_intro: Ikujatana kwa USB kuchibelesyo chako kwaleka kubeleka. Sikusobana wako uyandika kujokezyegwa amaanza kakutanaba kusoleka kumwi.
strings.retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Gwisya ntambo ya USB kuzwa kuchibelesyo chako.
strings.retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Tyanka bbatani lyakujokezya lisisidwe a pini, pepa lyakujatila naa nkomo yakumatwi.
strings.retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Kojokezya ntambo ya USB, mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Sala 'USB Storage Mode' achibelesyo chako.
2. Tyanka 'Browse Folder...' kuti usale sikusobana wako akubikka mitwe yamakani.

strings.rockbox_site_themes_open: Jula busena bwamutwe wamakani wa Rockbox
strings.rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Basikusobana bainda kumwi baliswaangenyi. Kogwisya zimwi mpawo usiye buyo eeyo iibikkwa.
strings.rockbox_stage_pushing: Sikusobana wakajanwa. Kubikka mitwe yamakani yabantu boonse amabala...

strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kusungilizya mitwe yamakani amabala aa ADB...

strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Taakwe chintu cha ADB chakajanika mukati kamasekondi aali 30; kuzumanana a USB Storage Mode.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Ntaamu yabili: Kuyandaula sikusobana kwiinda ADB...
strings.rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Lino ulakonzya kugwisya chisobano kakunyina ntenda mpawo usale mutwe wamakani mu Rockbox (Mabambe > Mabambe amutwe wamakani).
strings.rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Taakwe ADB binary iijanika mu app; kuzumanana a USB Storage Mode.

1. Gwisya ntambo ya USB.
2. Bikka nguzu zyakusobana mpawo uzileke kuti zitalike kunjila mu Rockbox.
3. Ikuti Rockbox yatalika kubeleka, swaanizya ntambo ya USB, mpawo utyanke Kuzumanana.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kojatisya bbatani lyanguzu kuti ujule chibelesyo chako, jata USB, mpawo usale USB Storage Mode.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kojatisya bbatani lyaakati kuti ujule Y1 yako, jata USB, mpawo usale USB Storage Mode.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Ntaamu 1: Talika alimwi sikusobana mpawo ubwezelezye
strings.rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Bikka nzila yakubamba USB aachipekupeku kuchitila kuti iboneke mbuli ntambo.
2. Sala fooloda iili yoonse aachipekupeku chili munsi (.rockbox, Nyimbo, Mitwe, naakuti muyanda wa drive, fooloda ya .rockbox iisisidwe ilajanika biyo).
3. App eeyi ilaswaanganya mitwe yamakani a 360p amabala, akulemba ma fayela aamazina aakozyenye.
strings.rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Bikka kwiinda mukubelesya nzila yakubamba ya USB
strings.sel_cache_retry_select_release: Sala nzila ya firmware kuti uyigwisye alimwi.
strings.sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Jokela ku Select Software kuti uyake lubo naakuti ubweze pulogilamu ya firmware.
strings.sel_install_tooltip: Bikka naa kubweedezya pulogilamu ya system yasalwa ku {lbl} yako
strings.sel_install_tooltip_generic: Bikka naakuti kubweedezya pulogilamu ya system yasalwa kuchibelesyo chako
strings.sel_instructions_below: Kotobelezya malailile aali ansi aawa kuti ubike pulogilamu eeyi a {lbl} yako
strings.sel_keep_data_incompatible: Tatukonzyi kubamba data yako mukubikka ooku nkaambo firmware yako yamazubaano tayeendelani a Keep Data.
strings.sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ma firmware miingi naakuti ma scatter files akajanwa mu folda/chiyobwedo eechi. Twalomba kuti usale fooloda naakuti busena bwakuyobweda zintu bujisi buyo firmware yomwe achiindi chomwe.
strings.sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Ooku kwaambilizya kuli ama fayela aayinda kuli yomwe, aboobo Sikubambulula takonzyi kwaamba kuti sikusobana wako uyanda nzila nzi. Basikupanga {software} beelede kuchincha zyintu zyabo zya firmware kuti zibikkilizye buyo fayela lyomwe.
strings.sel_notes_hint: Sala zyakugwisya kuti ubone zyintu zyakachinchwa
strings.sel_offline: Malembe aali a intaneti taaliwo pe lino. Belesya fayela lyamuunzi, naakuti langa kujatana kwako.
strings.sel_offline_install: Kobikka firmware kuzwa ku .zip naa .rar fayela kuli Innioasis naa Timmkoo audio player.
strings.sel_offline_install_generic: Bikka firmware kuzwa ku .zip/.rar archive naakuti firmware folda kuzibelesyo zya MediaTek.
strings.sel_only_local: Sala .zip naa .rar firmware yakubusena ooko kuti ukonzye kubikka kakunyina intaneti, kunyina intaneti iiyandika pe. Ibeleka a Innioasis a Timmkoo audio player yoonse.
strings.sel_only_local_generic: Sala bbokesi lya firmware (.zip, .rar) naakuti fooloda ilijisi fayela lyakubelesya kakunyina intaneti, lilabeleka azibelesyo zya MediaTek.
strings.sel_prompt_need_firmware: Twalomba kuti usale .zip, .rar archive, naakuti scatter file (*scatter*.txt) mukati ka folda ya firmware kuti ubike firmware njosala a {target} yako.
strings.sel_source_desc: Kopolola pulogilamu ya firmware egubi, naakuti ubweze zyintu zyako.
strings.sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Twalomba kuti ugwisye USB, ujale manguzu mpawo ubweze Rockbox chiindi chomwe (mbuli kuti italisye .rockbox system folder), mpawo ubweze USB mpawo usale 'USB Storage Mode'.

Kuti waswaanganya, tyanka kuti uzumanane kusala folda iili yoonse aachipekupeku chako.

strings.sel_themepack_prompt_body: Watondezya 360p Rockbox kuyaka. Sena inga wayanda kubikka 360p Theme Pack aachibelesyo eechi lino?
strings.sel_themepack_select_folder: Sala chiyobwedo chilichose mubbokesi lyasikusobana wako uujatikizyidwe
strings.sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yabikkwa kabotu aachibelesyo chako!
strings.sel_type_help_body:
Amusole pulogilamu ya Type A System Software.

Ikuti naa vwili lyako lyakuvwungulula talikonzyi kuvwiila nikwakamana kubikwa, bikka chimwi cha Type B.

Zibelesyo zya Type B nzizyeezyo zyakaboola a firmware yakusaanguna kwiinda 2.0.
strings.sel_type_help_tooltip: Amusole pulogilamu ya Type A System Software. Kuti vwili lyako lyakuvwungulula talikonzyi kuvwiila nikwakamana kubikwa, bikka chimwi cha Type B.
strings.sel_update_available: Kuli zyintu zipya zya {software} ziliwo ku {model} yako.
strings.settings_240p_tip: Chitondeezya ziyaka zili a ROM zip zili 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p zyakayakwa tazyeendelani a Y1 yuniti a Innioasis OS munsi a 3.0.7, aboobo Show Old Rockbox Builds zilazumizigwa anzizyo.
strings.settings_add_device_no_versions: Taakwe nzila ziliwo zyapulogilamu eeyi lino.
strings.settings_advanced_desc: Yubununa ma flash backends aali munsi-munsi anzila zyakubikka terminal.
strings.settings_allow_keep_data_any: Chiindi choonse kopa kuti uzumanane kubamba zintu zyangu azintu zyangu
strings.settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Ulainda mubuzyo wakuzuminana. Kobelesya eechi biyo kuti koli masimpe kuti sikusobana uyoozumanana kubeleka amaseti aama media.
strings.settings_arm64_driver_note: Lugwasyo lwa ARM64 Windows talunasunkwa pe. Kuma laputopu aa Snapdragon antoomwe a RTX Spark, Zadig ilakonzya kubelesegwa a Driver Signature Enforcement kaitabelesyegwi kubikka WinUSB naa libusb ya MT6227 Preloader device mu Device Manager. Langa ARM64 malailile aakweenzya kuti ujane ntaamu.
strings.settings_cache_desc: Zima ma firmware aakagwisigwa antoomwe ama fayela aa ROM aagwisigwa kuchitila kuti kube busena bwa disk. Makani aako aakubikka antoomwe azintu nzyoyanda kuyeezya zyakucinca zilakwabililwa.
strings.settings_checker_desc: Ulibambila injini iimweka, mpawo ulalanga-langa kunjila kwa USB, tubunga twababelesi antoomwe ama modules aa kernel serial.
strings.settings_checker_desc_advanced: Langa kubamba kwa Linux kwasumpukide kwa SP Flash Tool, kunjila kwa USB, zyeelelo zya serial, azibeela zya system.
strings.settings_checker_desc_friendly: Ibamba kkompiyuta yako kuti ikonzye kuswaangana a player yako mpawo ibike zintu zipya zyapulogilamu munzila iisyomeka.
strings.settings_checker_desc_installer: Ibambila kkompyuta yako kuti ijatane achibelesyo chako kuti ichite zyintu zipya.
strings.settings_driver_desc: Kotana ubelesya pulogilamu eeyi mchiindi chakusanguna, weelede kubikka MediaTek USB driver, mpawo ubweze kkompyuta yako.

strings.settings_enable_y2: Bikka ziyeekezyo zyakugwisya zya Innioasis Y2
strings.settings_firmware_up_to_date: Zibelesyo zyoonse zitobelezegwa zilikubelesya ma firmware mapya!
strings.settings_guided_install_desc: App eeyi ilakkala anduwe kwiinda mukuzima, kuswaanganya, akubika.
strings.settings_hide_donations_tip: Kusisa nzila zyakusanga amabbatani. Ulakonzya kuula kkofi kuzwa kuZyakuchita kuti koyanda.
strings.settings_install_themes_desc: Kuti yazumizigwa, mitwe ya Rockbox ilachinchwa kuli Y1 musule lyakubikkwa kwa Rockbox.
strings.settings_no_devices_tracked: Kunyina kubikkwa kwaminchina kwakalembedwe pe. Fwesya chibelesyo kuchitila kuti ukonzye kutobelezya nzila.
strings.settings_not_installed: Kunyina kubikka kwakalekkoodwa lino (kuyobolwa biyo nikwakamana kupya)
strings.settings_notifications_desc: Tondezya zizibisyo zya system zyazizibisyo azintu zipya zili ansi aawa. Off ulabamba zyoonse zili mukati ka app.
strings.settings_notifications_unavailable: Zizibisyo zya system tazijaniki aa kkompyuta eeyi.
strings.settings_offline_mode_desc: Sisa bbuku lyamakani aabantu bali aa intaneti mpawo ubike pulogilamu kuzwa kumafayela aamumunzi luzutu.
strings.settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Kuzwa kwa Rockbox-Y1 kakutanaba 0.5 takubeleki antoomwe a Y1 yakasambalwa musule lya mwezi wa Nsondo 2026 Innioasis OS 3.0.7 yakabikkidwe kale.

Kubelesya zyintu zyakale zyakabambwa azibelesyo eezyi kuyoopa kuti kutabi kutalika.

Sena masimpe kuti uyanda kutondezya zintu zyakale zya Rockbox?
strings.settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Mapulogilamu aakusaanguna aakaindi kwiinda 3.0.7 taali kweendelana amayuniti aa Y1 aasambalwa a Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Kubelesya nzila yakaindi aazibelesyo eezyi kuyoopa kuti zitabeleki kusikila nzila mpya yabikkwa alimwi.

Sena masimpe kuti uyanda kutondezya mapulogilamu aakusaanguna aakaindi kwiinda 3.0.7?
strings.settings_reminders_desc: Sikubambulula ulayeeya kuti ncibeela nzi cha firmware chakabikkidwe kuma Innioasis players aako, akuchenjezya aawo zipya nozizwa.
strings.settings_reminders_tracked: Uyoochenjezegwa aawo zyintu zipya nozizwa zyapulogilamu njoobikka a {devices}. Zyakatobelwa lino: {software}
strings.settings_reminders_tracked_multi: Tulakuzibya aawo zibeela zipya zyazeezi noziyoozwa.
strings.settings_reminders_tracked_named: Tulakuzibya aawo nzila mpya ya {software} niyazwa kuli {model} yako.
strings.settings_reminders_tracked_original: Tulakuzibya aawo pulogilamu mpya ya {model} yako niyazwa.
strings.settings_rockbox_desc: Chibelesegwa aawo notulanga zyintu zyakazwa mupulogilamu.
strings.settings_run_as_admin_desc: buzya Windows kuti akupe nguzu zyakweendelezya aawo kubikka nokwatalika. SP Flash Tool antoomwe a MTKClient mpawo babeleka kabajisi nguzu zyoonse, nzila yakujana mapenzi aawo sikubbabbanisya naakuti port nozikaka kujalula.
strings.settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Sikubambulula yeelede kutalika alimwi kuchitila kuti zintu zibikkwe zibeleke azyeelelo eezi.
strings.settings_run_as_superuser_desc: Chita kubikka azyeelelo zya root kwiinda mu pkexec. Chibelesye aawo kulubizya kwakuzumizya nokwakasya chibelesyo cha flash.
strings.settings_run_in_background_desc: Bikka pulogilamu eeyi mubbuku lyamenyu naakuti mubbokesi lyamapulogilamu nikwakamana kujalwa windo, kuchitila kuti ukonzye kutambula zizibisyo zyakucinca kwapulogilamu alubono. Kuzima: kujala windo kulagwisya pulogilamu.

strings.settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Bikka pulogilamu eeyi mubbokesi lyamapulogilamu nikwakamana kujalwa windo, kuchitila kuti ukonzye kutambula zizibisyo zyakubambulula pulogilamu alubono. Kuzima: kujala windo kulagwisya pulogilamu.
strings.settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Tondezya twaambo tuuba-uba twakumanizya kakunyina kulomba lugwasyo wamana kumweka.
strings.settings_sp_auth_desc: Chakulisalila. Zimwi zintu zya MediaTek zilakaka kumweka kusikila SP Flash Tool yapegwa fayela lyakusinizya (.auth); bika lyako aawa kuti chibelesyo chiyanda.

strings.settings_sp_gui_install: Bika mu SP Flash Tool GUI

strings.settings_terminal_desc_windows: Chichita kubikka pulogilamu yako mu Command Prompt kuchitila kuti ubone makani aabusongo aatala akuyaambele.

strings.single_instance_body: Imwi kkopi ilijulidwe, naakuti ichibeleka musule. Makkopi obile alakonzya kuzundana kuti sikusobana ajane luswaangano lwa USB, aboobo eyi taikonzyi kutalika pe.
strings.single_instance_busy_body: Ikkopi iibeleka nkubikka pulogilamu naakuti kwaambuula asikusobana, aboobo kumanizya lino inga kwanyonganya eecho. Ooku kutalisya kuyoojalwa; kobelesya windo liliwo naakuti chikozyano cha menyu aawo kubikka kwamana.
strings.single_instance_focus_failed: Ikkopi iibeleka tiiyakavwiila kukumbila kutondezya windo lyayo. Ulakonzya kuchileka mpawo utalike eechi.
strings.single_instance_force_failed: Ikkopi yakalikuchitika tiiyakakonzya kumanizyigwa pe. Chileke omwini, mpawo utalike kuchita zintu zipya alimwi.
strings.sp_auth_missing_file: Fayila yakusinizya tiiyakajanwa pe ({path}); kumweka kakunyina ncico.
strings.sp_config_missing_platform: I fayela lya scatter talitondezyi nzila yalyo, aboobo bubambe bwa console bwa fayela lyakusinizya tabukonzyi kuyakwa pe; kumweka kakunyina ncico.
strings.sp_config_missing_storage: I fayela lya scatter talyaambilizyi musyobo wakubamba (EMMC/NAND/UFS), aboobo bubambe bwa console bwa fayela lyakusinizya tiibwakali kukonzya kuyakwa pe; kumweka kakunyina ncico.
strings.sp_config_no_auth_file: Taakwe fayela lyakusinizya lyakapegwa; kumweka kakunyina yomwe.

strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI lino iyoojaluka aawo firmware yako niyakabikkwa kale.

• Mu SP Flash Tool, kkopa "Forma All + Download" kuzwa kubbokesi lizwa ansi.
• Tyanka bbatani lyakuti "Downlole".
• Bona kuti {device} chako chilizimidwe akugwisigwa.
{hint}
• Swaanganya ntambo ya USB ku kkompyuta yako wamana kutyola Download.

Dina OK kuti utalike SP Flash Tool mpawo uzwe mu Sikubambulula.
strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Bikka kwiinda mu SP Flash Tool GUI
strings.sp_gui_launch_intro:
SP Flash Tool GUI lino ilatalika.

• Kuti tiikwazima, zima chibelesyo chako.
• Kuti yakajatikizyigwa a USB, kosaanguna kuchigwisya.
• Mu SP Flash Tool, tyanka Kopolola (naa Kubamba Zyoonse + Kopolola mbuli mbokuyandika).

Mpawo jata ntambo ya USB kuti utalike kumweka.
strings.sp_gui_no_cached_firmware: Kunyina bbokesi lya firmware lyakavwumbidwe kuzwa mukusola kubikka kwakaindi lyakajanika, naakuti zifwanikiso zyakwaandaanya ziyandika taziko pe. Twalomba kuti usale naa kudonwula pulogilamu yakamwaigwa katana jula SP Flash Tool.
strings.sp_gui_not_supported: SP Flash Tool GUI ilajanika buyo a Windows antoomwe a Linux (x86/x86_64) systems.
strings.sp_gui_preparing_firmware: Ibbokesi lya firmware talizulide pe, koli kugwisya akugwisya kotana jula SP Flash Tool.

strings.support_methods_subtitle: Sala nzila yakugwasya njoyanda. Kugwasizya kuli koonse kugwasya kugwisya, kubamba, akusunka zibelesyo.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis lyoonse ilagwisya ma firmware mapya aabasikusobanya mbuli Y1 (aalanganya mabboodi aasisidwe mbuli 6.0, 7.0, antoomwe a 8.0) aayo aatyola zibelesyo zyakale. Chiinda kubija, webbusaiti yabo taikwe nchenjezyo pe mpawo taikwe nzila yakunjila muma firmware aakali kubeleka musule kuti bapiluke kuzwa kuchiimo chakubula nguzu. Sikubambulula antoomwe a Community Firmware project balabweza zibeela: tulabamba ROM yoonse yakaindi, mpawo tulasinizya kuti zibelesyo zyako zyakabambululwa, mpawo tulabamba kuti chibelesyo chako chibeleke kabotu.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Basikupanga nibaunka kunembo, bantu bamuchilawu balasumpuka.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Kuvwuna Basikusobana Batyokede: Kulanga-langa lukwabililo kulasinizya kuti zintu zipya tazinyonganyi zibelesyo zyakaindi.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Ma ROM aakali kuyobolwa: Kuyobolola koonse kwama firmware aakusaanguna aakapangwa Innioasis akagwisigwa.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Zibelesyo Zyakubelesya Zyoonse: Zibelesyo zyakumweka zyoonse zya macOS, Linux, antoomwe a Windows.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Busongo bwazibelesyo: Kuzyiba bboodi kuchitila kuti lyoonse ujane zyintu zyeelede.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Kukwabilila chibelesyo chako kuzwa kuzyintu zitakwe jwi alimwi azintu zityokede.
strings.support_story_2_body: Kuvwuntauzya pulogilamu ya Innioasis iizumizyidwe kanjikanji chaamba kuyandaula mafoomu kuti ujane zijazyo zya Google Drive zyamana chiindi, zibeela zya Baidu zyamakumbi zifwide, ama fayela aa zip aatazyibidwe aatakwe zibelesyo zyakumweka. Twakayaka nzila iisyomeka, iitakwe mpuwo yakugwisya zintu zya SHA-256, zizibisyo zyakucinca, antoomwe akubikka zintu munzila iitobelezegwa. Lugwasyo lwako lulabamba zintu zyakugwisya akubamba eezyo zipa kuti eezi zichitike mawoola aali 24 abuzuba, mazuba aali 365 amwaka.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Taakwe Google Drives zityokede pe. Kunyina kweezyeezya. Firmware ibeleka biyo.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: CDN iifwambaana kapati: Kufwambaana, kudonkola kakunyina minyinza yakudonkola naa zijatikizyo zifwide.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Zizibisyo zyakusanduka: Kozibisyigwa aawo bantu bapya nobazwa naakuti kubambulula nokwazwa.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Kubikkwa kwaNtaamu-a-Ntaamu Kusololelwa: Zitondezyo ziboneka kabotu zilakusololela muchiindi choonse nityanka bbatani.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Chiinga chabantu babelesya myaambo myiingi: Chili muChikuwa, Chichaini, Chi German, Chispanishi, Chifulenchi aChijapani.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Zibelesyo zyamumunzi zifwambaana, zisinizyidwe nzyokonzya kusyoma.
strings.support_story_3_body: Mapulogilamu aafakitoli aajisi zintu zyakusambala alalanga buyo atala aazyintu nzyokonzya kuchita zibelesyo zyako zya Y1 naa Y2. Chiinga chesu chakaleta Rockbox, nzila zyakubelesya zitakatazyi pe, kulizya codec ya audiophile, antoomwe amitwe yamakani. Tulaula zibelesyo zyaandeene-andeene kuzwa munkomo yesu kuti tusunke, tupilusye, akusinizya kubikkwa koonse. Kugwasyilizya Sikubambulula kulagwasya mali kumasunko aaya akufwambaanya kupanga ma firmware.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Kuvwungulula nguzu zyoonse zya Innioasis yako.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Bbokesi lya Rock lyaKukkomauna Komwe: Kulizya kwa Audiophile alimwi amitwe yamakani iibikkwa mumasekondi masyoonto.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware yabantu boonse: Kuyungizya mabbattery, UI iisalala, antoomwe alugwasyo lwa audio codec lwamazubaano.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Tulasunka azibelesyo zini zini zini zini katutanagwisya zibelesyo zili zyoonse.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% yaalubazu, pulogilamu iibikkila maanu kukukwabilila makani aabantu kakunyina kwaambilizya naa kutobelezya.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Kuleta Rockbox, nzila zyakubelesya zitakatazyi pe, alwaanguluko lwabaswiilizi.
strings.support_story_4_body: Eelyo inkamu yazibelesyo zyakubelesya minchina niyaunka kuzibelesyo zyabo zimbi, zibelesyo zyakale zilalekelezyegwa. Innioasis taipi lugwasyo lwa Linux, taikwe ma changelogs aasalala, alimwi taikwe nzila nguba yakubukulusya aawo kubikka nokwaalilwa. Sikubambulula uliwo nkaambo babelesyi bayandisya tabeelede kusowa chibelesyo chibotu chakwiimba. 100% yazipego zyabantu zilaunka mukubamba chibelesyo eechi kuti chijalukide kumuntu uli oonse.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Kuvwuna akuvwungulula: Kubukulusya kwakasinizyigwa kuti kulachitika nikuba kuti minchina yakakaka kutalika.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Lugwasyo lwa Linux Lwakusaanguna: Lugwasyo luzulide lwa MediaTek iimweka-mweka a Linux distros.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Malembe aakusanduka aatakwe kampenda: Malembe aazwa antangalala kuchitila kuti uzyibe loko kuchincha.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Lugwasyo Lwabantu: Ikofi yoonse ilabamba busena bwakuyobweda zintu kuti kabujalukide mpawo kabuli bwaalubazu kuliboonse.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Kukwabililwa kwa firmware kweendelezyegwa abantu boonse ikukwabilila zibelesyo zyako kuti zitanjili mumasena aakusowela tombe.
strings.system_checker_desc: Kusinizya koonse kwama driver, ma kernel modules, zyeelelo, amalayibbulali aakubelesya muchiindi chakubeleka kuchitila kuti kube kumweka kubotu.
strings.system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
strings.terminal_hint_generic: • Njiisyo: Kobikka chibelesyo chako muchiimo chakudonkola firmware (zilaandeene kweendelanya amusyobo: mbuli kuti gwisya bbattery mpawo ulibikke anze kakuli ntambo ya USB iijatikizyidwe, naa kuzima magesi kakuli bbattery ili mukati, naa kujatisya Volume Down/Up aawo noswaanganya USB).
strings.terminal_hint_innioasis: • Njiisyo: Kuti kachibelesyo kachitajatikizyi pe, tyanka bbatani lyakujokezya mubbokesi lyamapepa aawo noliswaanganya ntambo ya USB.
strings.terminal_install_failed: Tachikonzyi kujalula windo lya terminal. Mulawu wakubikka wakalembwa kuli {path}.
strings.terminal_install_no_scatter: Kunyina fayela lyamwaika lyakajanika mubbokesi eeli, aboobo taakwe mulawu wa console wakakonzya kuyakwa.
strings.terminal_install_no_tool: Taakwe SP Flash Tool build naa MTKClient entry point iiliko munzila eeyi.
strings.terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} lino ilajula kakuli {method}.

• Kuti kachitanazima, zima {device} chako.
• Kuti yakajatikizyigwa a USB, kosaanguna kuchigwisya.
{hint}
• Swaanganya chibelesyo chako kukkompyuta yako aawo windo lya {terminal_name} nolyajulwa.

Dina OK kuti utalike akuzwa mu Sikubambulula.
strings.themepack_card_desc: Zibikkilizya mitwe yamakani mibotu yabantu, zifwanikiso zyakumbele ziboneka kabotu, amabala aakabambilwa zitondezyo zya 360p.
strings.themepack_complete: Ibbokesi lyamutwe wamakani lyakabikkwa kabotu! Lino ulakonzya kugwisya chibelesyo chako kakunyina ntenda mpawo usale mutwe wamakani mu Rockbox (Zyakubamba > Zyakubamba zyamutwe wamakani).
strings.themepack_err_not_found: Tachikonzeka pe kujana naa kutalisya .rockbox directory a drive yasalwa. Kosinizya kuti wasala fooloda aachibelesyo chako.
strings.themepack_step1_desc:
1. Jula chibelesyo chako kwiinda mukujatisya bbatani lya Power.
2. Eelyo Rockbox niyatalika, bikka ntambo ya USB mukkompyuta yako.
3. Kuti wabuzyigwa aachipekupeku, sinizya nzila yakubamba USB kuchitila kuti chibelesyo chiboneke mbuli ntambo.
strings.themepack_step1_title: Ntaamu 1: Swaanganya mu USB Storage Mode
strings.themepack_step2_desc: Nkaambo kakuti nzila zyakubelesya (mbuli macOS) zilasisa ma dotfile (mbuli .rockbox) mbuli mbozibede, ulakonzya kusala folda iili yoonse naakuti drive root a player yako. Tulakujana naa kukupangila .rockbox directory.
strings.themepack_step2_title: Ntaamu yabili: Sala fooloda iili yoonse aachipekupeku
strings.themes_placement_failed_note: Twakaalilwa kubikka bbokesi lyamitwe yamakani aachipekupeku chako. Ulakonzya kusola alimwi kuzwa kuZyakuchita.
strings.toast_battery_charged: Kotana ubelesya eechi achibelesyo chako, kosinizya kuti bbattery lili chaaji
strings.toast_battery_charged_device: Kotana ubelesya eechi achibelesyo chako, kosinizya kuti bbattery lili chaaji
strings.update_check_failed: Tachikonzyi kulanga zyintu zipya lino. Langa kujatana kwako mpawo usole alimwi.
strings.update_install_generic: Kopolola {hint} kuzwa apeeji lyakugwisya mpawo utobelezye malailile aakubikka zyintu zyako.
strings.update_install_linux: Kokkola {hint}, uchichite kuti chibeleke, mpawo uchibelesye, chibweza busena bwamusyobo wakaindi.
strings.update_install_mac: Kokkola {hint}, kojula, mpawo kokwela pulogilamu eeyi mufooloda yako yamapulogilamu.
strings.update_install_win: Kopolola {hint} mpawo uchibelesye. Sikubikka ulabweza busena bwamusyobo uuliko lino; zyeelelo zyako antoomwe a firmware njowakakkopa zilabikkwa.
